command: kubectl get deployment -n pricing-d42c -o wide | grep -i quote

kubectl patch service quote -n pricing-d42c --type=merge -p '{"spec": {"selector": {"release": null}}}'
kubectl get pods -n pricing-d42c -L release | grep -i quote
kubectl get pods -n pricing-d42c -L release | grep -i quote
sleep 3 && kubectl get pods -n pricing-d42c -L release | grep -i quote
